accessibility.title: Worker uplift operating state and future cutover gates
accessibility.description: The diagram shows that legacy ingestion remains the production owner while operators gather read-only evidence and keep the uplift shadow-only. Future cutover can only happen after separate approved controls are added, the DNS failover system stays independent, and a reversible watermark-based switch is proven.

review_notes: Resolved for this draft: the issue sequence, repository commits, workflow names and inputs, provider-credential mapping, Grafana catalog, evidence runs, and artifact digest were checked against the refreshed 2026-07-29 GitHub state.
Resolved for this draft: Backend Production Cutover is database-provider automation and is explicitly excluded from worker-ingestion promotion.

Resolved for this draft: the pinned infra controller config has the Durable Object binding but no FAILOVER_ANALYTICS binding; the guide records proof, migration, or residual-risk acceptance as a #125 gate.
Recheck these time-sensitive baselines whenever an owning repository changes; a mismatch is a readiness blocker until the guide is updated.
